owner: FIX_SHOOT_ATTACHED_RANGE (shooting: measure a shot to every model of the target's Attached unit)
rationale: 11e 04.02 (Select Targets): each ranged target must be visible and 'Within range of that weapon'; 01.04.01 (errata commentary): 'A unit is within a specified distance if one or more of its models are within that distance'; 19.01: 'An attached unit is a single unit for all rules purposes'. So an Attached unit is in range of a weapon when only its leader is. Here U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_A (5 x 40 mm, guardian spears 24") stands on open ground (terrain cleared: the exam is about range, not sight lines) 23" from the Warboss attached to U_BOYZ_B and 25.6" or more from every Boy, and nothing else of either army is within 30" of anything: the engine lists the Boyz as an eligible target with the spears in range (asserts 1-2 check this on the engine, so the exam cannot drift into passing by layout). An AI that measures range to the bodyguard's own models only prices every shot at 0 and skips 'no valid targets in range' — it throws its whole Shooting phase away. Assert 3 is the decision (the unit shot the Boyz), not the dice.
setup: # Behaviour under test ships OFF: switch it on for player 1 only. Loaded
# inline (not from the bench profile) so the exam names exactly the knob
# Open ground: the exam measures range only.
# The shooter: a 65 px line at y 400.
# The Warboss (attached to Boyz B) 23" edge to edge south of the middle
# Custodian: 23" + two 20 mm base radii = 983 px centre to centre.
# The Boyz in coherency with him, one line further south: 1080 px (27")
# centre to centre from the Custodians' line, 25.6" edge to edge or more.
# Everyone else parked, stacked per side: player 1 in the north-east
# corner, player 2 in the south-east corner — over 40" apart, out of every
# weapon's reach, and over 30" from the Custodians / the Boyz.
if uid == "U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_A" or uid == "U_WARBOSS_A" or uid == "U_BOYZ_B":

assert.name: precondition: the Warboss is attached to the Boyz, within 24" of a Custodian; no Boy is (01.04.01)
script: # Engine precondition, independent of the AI: the setup's positions.
return attached and near_boss <= 24.0 and near_boy > 24.0

assert.name: precondition: the engine lists the Boyz as an eligible target, the guardian spear in range (04.02, 19.01)
script: # Engine precondition, independent of the AI: the setup's positions,
# before any shot (has_shot / the 13.09 stamp cleared).

assert.name: Custodian Guard A shot at the Boyz (a shooting record whose chosen target is U_BOYZ_B)
script: if ci >= 0 and ci < c.size() and str(c[ci].get("target_unit_id", "")) == "U_BOYZ_B":

assert.name: and the shot was really made: Custodian Guard A carries this turn's 13.09 shot stamp
